$comment: Canonical cross-implementation FIPS protocol vectors (P5 cross-vectors expansion, cashu-cross-vectors model). Homes: fips-protocol-defs-mvp (this file, validated against profiles/), microfips (crates/microfips-core/tests/golden_vectors.json consumers), Wireshark dissector (tools/fips_dissector.lua). Extend, never edit, existing vectors. Frame bytes are exact where deterministic (headers, lengths); crypto-dependent regions are marked 'crypto' and pinned by the noise_ik golden handshake instead.
$provenance: profile fips-v0-ik-xk @ jmcorgan/fips v0.4.0 (d5ee526); msg1 bytes generated by microfips (crates/microfips-core golden_vectors_ik.rs harness, scalar 0x11 static / epoch 0x01)

link_message_types.$spec: FMP v0 link-layer message type byte to name; every implementation and dissector must agree on the full table

fmp_frame_layouts.$spec: FMP v0 frame sizes derived from profile constants; COMMON_PREFIX_SIZE=4, ESTABLISHED_HEADER_SIZE=16, INNER_HEADER_SIZE=5, handshake payloads per noise IK/XK

vectors.composition: COMMON_PREFIX_SIZE(4) + u32 len(4) + u32 tag(4) + HANDSHAKE_MSG2_SIZE(57)

noise_ik_msg1_golden.$spec: Byte-exact IK msg1 with deterministic keys: initiator static = scalar 0x11 repeated, epoch 0x0100000000000000. Same vector as fixtures/noise_ik_golden.json (microfips-generated); pinned here so every home references ONE canonical file
invariants: msg1[0:33] == initiator EPHEMERAL compressed pubkey (Noise IK: e.pub leads; static key travels encrypted in es)
first 8 bytes of the es ciphertext region decrypt-under-golden-keys to the static pubkey + init_epoch framing

wireshark_dissector_pins.$spec: Structural markers the Lua dissector must key on; ensures tools/fips_dissector.lua stays wire-compatible (fips-lab carries the same file)

vectors.note: dissector tables must use link_message_types above verbatim
